caption: The drawing features a symmetrical folk-art design centered on a large red heart shape at the bottom. Above the heart, there is a large, circular flower head composed of alternating red and blue wedge-shaped sections, with white petal-like shapes radiating from the center, and a ring of jagged blue and red edge accents forming the perimeter of the flower. Emanating upward from the heart are two curved black stems supporting two yellow tulip-shaped flowers with red inner petals on either side of the central flower. Each curved stem extends downward beneath the heart and ends in a circular motif; each circle has a blue six-pointed star with a red center, circumscribed in yellow, forming a geometric pattern. The background is a plain creamy beige color, and the overall composition is made up of red, yellow, blue, black, and white shapes arranged in a balanced and decorative manner. At the bottom center, text reads: "FROM A DOWER CHEST C. 1790" and smaller text below indicates the context as an example of "FOLK ART OF RURAL PENNSYLVANIA."
title: Plate 13: From the Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
